title: Finite radicial descent of the Noetherian-test direct-image property
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and $v:S'\to S$ a finite, surjective, universally injective morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $a_Y:Y\to S$ be a morphism, $j:X\to Y$ an open immersion, and $F$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$. Choose Cartesian squares $Y'\to Y$ over $S'\to S$, with projections $p_Y:Y'\to Y$ and $b_Y:Y'\to S'$, and $X'\to X$ over $Y'\to Y$, with projections $p_X:X'\to X$ and $j':X'\to Y'$. Put $F'=p_X^*F$. Assume that for every Noetherian scheme $T$ and morphism $T\to S'$, and every Cartesian presentation of the pullback of $j'$, the complex $Rj'_{T,*}Lp_{X,T}^*(F'[0])$ is bounded constructible [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] and the canonical exchange [sbc-def-base-change-map] from the pullback of $Rj'_*F'[0]$ to that complex is invertible. Then for every Noetherian $T\to S$, and every Cartesian presentation of the pullback of $j$, the analogous direct image on $Y_T$ is bounded constructible and its canonical exchange from the pullback of $Rj_*F[0]$ is invertible. This is precisely descent of the predicate $\mathrm{HasConstructibleDirectImageBaseChangeOn}$ on the entire base. It makes no assertion about bounded constructibility of $Rj_*F[0]$ on $Y$ itself when $S$ is not Noetherian.

proof.text: Fix a Noetherian test T over S, and form T'=T times_S S'. Since the projection T' to T is finite, it is finite type and T' is Noetherian. Finite, surjective, universally injective morphisms and their pullbacks are universal homeomorphisms. Thus T' is an admissible test for the hypothesis upstairs.

proof.text: Inverse image along each universal homeomorphism is an exact equivalence on module sheaves and derived categories. It commutes with cohomology and detects zero objects and constructibility. For constructibility, transport the finite constructible stratification by the homeomorphism; local constancy descends by the site equivalence, and finite stalks descend by stalk comparison at points with the same image. Consequently bounded constructibility of the direct image on the T' test descends to the direct image on T.

source.place: Proof, Noetherian test schemes and exchange descent; existing source declaration WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/Etale/Derived/Finiteness/Deligne.lean:135-143

proof.text: In the pullback cube over T and T', the canonical exchanges along the universal homeomorphisms are isomorphisms by the mate lemma. Cartesian pasting and the canonical exchange-composition identity identify the two composites around the cube. The exchange for the T' test upstairs is an isomorphism by hypothesis. Cancel the cover exchanges, then reflect invertibility through the cover inverse-image equivalence. This gives the canonical exchange for T. Together with the previous step it gives both clauses of HasConstructibleDirectImageBaseChangeOn for every Noetherian test.
